nodes.prompt: Run static analysis on C++ engine code in TIBERIANDAWN/ and REDALERT/. Check for: memory leaks (manual allocators), buffer overflows, uninitialized variables, deterministic simulation issues, and Westwood-era patterns that may be unsafe. Output findings to /tmp/cnc-audit-{{key}}-cpp.md

Analyze CnCTDRAMapEditor/ C# code for: WinForms UI thread blocking, Steamworks.NET integration issues, memory pressure from map rendering, game data structure mapping correctness, and Steam Workshop publishing reliability. Output to /tmp/cnc-audit-{{key}}-csharp.md

Verify both solutions build: CnCRemastered.sln (C++ engines) and CnCTDRAMapEditor.sln (C# editor). Check for: SDK version mismatches, packing alignment errors, missing MFC/Windows 8.1 SDK dependencies, and x86/x64 configuration issues. Output to /tmp/cnc-audit-{{key}}-build.md

Compare TIBERIANDAWN/ and REDALERT/ architectures for: shared base class divergences (AbstractClass, BuildingClass, AircraftClass), manager singleton inconsistencies (Audio, Animation, Network, Resource), file format handler differences, and mission scripting variations. Output to /tmp/cnc-audit-{{key}}-consistency.md

Synthesize all findings from /tmp/cnc-audit-{{key}}-*.md into a final prioritized report at /tmp/cnc-audit-{{key}}-FINAL.md with: CRITICAL (build blockers, memory safety), HIGH (determinism risks, Steam integration), MEDIUM (maintainability, consistency), LOW (style, docs). Include file:line references.
